name: What is the cost of new cabinets from Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of new cabinets from Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new cabinets depends on several factors, including the type of material, cabinet style, finishes, and the overall size of the project. Custom cabinets tend to be a larger investment than semi-custom or stock options. We offer detailed estimates after understanding your specific requirements and design preferences during the consultation phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet costs depend on material, style, finishes, and project size. We provide estimates after a consultation.
